records.name: Shedi
records.tagline: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate
records.description: The honest Mac cleaner. Shedi finds what Xcode, Docker, node_modules and 20+ package managers left on your Mac, says what each item is and whether it comes back, and cleans only what you pick. Everything goes to the Trash first. Pay once.

records.name: Penta
records.tagline: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo
records.description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

records.name: myPip
records.tagline: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI
records.description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

records.name: Canva Craft
records.tagline: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit
records.description: Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

records.name: LinkIntel
records.tagline: Post insights delivered direct to your AI
records.description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

records.name: AgentValley
records.tagline: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch
records.description: It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

records.name: 1Password for Agents
records.tagline: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords
records.description: 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

records.name: zCAD AI
records.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
records.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

records.name: How It Went
records.tagline: Your route, photos and clips as a short film
records.description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.

records.name: sideOS.ai
records.tagline: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more
records.description: sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

records.name: River Writer
records.tagline: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels
records.description: River Writer is a free Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels. You write plain text (.fountain ormd) and a live preview shows the formatted, print-ready pages beside it: Screenplay, Multi-cam, Stage Play or Manuscript. Git versioning is built in, so you can commit drafts, restore files and try an alternate ending on a branch. Outline, scratchpad and todos live as plain files in your project. No accounts, cloud, telemetry or AI; it makes no network connections. Open source (MIT).

records.name: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
records.tagline: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.
records.description: Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

records.name: Byter
records.tagline: Know exactly how much data you use, on every network
records.description: Byter shows how much internet data you use, and where. It tracks usage separately for every Wi‑Fi network, phone hotspot and wired connection, so you know exactly what your hotspot bundle went on. You also get live speed, a one-click speed test, daily-to-yearly charts, and gentle alerts when usage spikes. Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads. Available now for Mac, Windows coming soon, in 11 languages.

records.name: Many Displays
records.tagline: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging
records.description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

records.name: Earshot
records.tagline: Earshot turns a spare phone into a listener for your home
records.description: Earshot turns a spare phone into a listener for your home. When it hears the smoke alarm, the doorbell, the baby or a sound you describe in your own words, everyone in your household gets an alert, wherever they are. Audio never leaves the phone.

records.name: MindChess
records.tagline: Your daily chess gym and study companion
records.description: MindChess is a daily chess gym for iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Mac: 60-second drills for board vision, memory and calculation. Version 1.3 adds a repertoire trainer with spaced repetition, a diagram scanner, a chess clock and Stockfish 19 offline (Pro).

records.name: Albumer
records.tagline: Shared photo albums and photo games for families and events
records.description: Albumer is a free app for sharing, storing and organizing photos on iPhone and Android. Share an album with anyone and they can add their own photos and videos, all kept at full size, whatever phone they use. Event albums come with QR codes and table signs, albums cast live to a TV, and a home screen widget shows your photos. Order Walgreens prints in the app. Plus photo games: puzzles, memory games, a photo scavenger hunt, Photo Tic-Tac-Toe, Color Dash and Caption This. In English and Spanish.

records.name: Vyasu.com
records.tagline: Hire Top Freelancers & Discover Talent for Any Project
records.description: Vyasu is your premier marketplace to find top-rated freelance experts in Design, Development, Writing, Marketing, and more. One Platform. Every Opportunity.

records.name: Kumuao.ai
records.tagline: Type a topic, get a tiny game that teaches it
records.description: Kumuao does one small thing well: type one small thing you want to teach/learn — fractions, photosynthesis, the 6 times table — and AI designs a tiny playable game around it, right there, right now: audience, style, and mechanics picked for you. Share it with a link; kids just play, no account needed. First 2 games free, no card.

records.name: Hirerizz
records.tagline: Know which jobs fit your resume before you apply
records.description: Upload your resume once. Hirerizz scores every job against it and shows what matches and what is missing, so you stop spending time on jobs that were never a fit. Every score comes with a reason. Then it helps you tailor your resume (without adding anything you have not done), write a cover letter for a specific job, prepare for the interview and remind you when to follow up. Built for marketing, tech and finance jobs in Delhi NCR, Bangalore and Mumbai. Try it free for 7 days, no card is needed.

records.name: OkiNoky
records.tagline: Reminders, notes, books, audiobooks & IPTV in Android app
records.description: OkiNoky is an all-in-one reminder app, daily planner, notepad, calendar, eBook reader, audiobook player and IPTV player. Organize tasks, notes, books, files and your own IPTV playlists in one clear and customizable app. Use OkiNoky as your personal organizer, to-do list, reminder app, notes app, calendar planner, book reader, audiobook player and IPTV player for your own playlists. OkiNoky is an IPTV player and does not provide TV channels, subscriptions or ready-made playlists. Channel...

records.description: VibeKit is a paid starter kit with 52 React landing-page templates, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind and a design system with 60+ components. The website and onboarding materials are currently in Portuguese.

records.name: PetCare

records.name: TubeVox AI

records.description: Download YouTube comments and replies to Excel, CSV & JSON

records.name: Stackplate

records.description: Type a dish from anywhere in the world, in any language. Its ingredients rise out of a pile and the recipe appears below. 900+ dishes, 12 languages, and a "what's in my kitchen" mode that finds what you can cook with what you have.

records.name: Dropify
records.tagline: Seamless shopping. Instant product alerts.
records.description: Seamless shopping. Instant product alerts. Dropify brings the official stores of the artists and brands you love into one place, with alerts you configure for the drops, restocks and changes that matter to you. Instant alerts. Your rules. Dropify is one cart for every store. Browse every tracked store and product in one centralized place. Add to a Dropify cart or list; export a cart to the store's checkout in one click; share lists easily.

records.name: Smart Reminder
records.tagline: The reminder app that emails you if you miss it
records.description: A simple to-do and reminder app for Android and iPhone. Turn on an email backup for any task, and if it’s still pending after the due time, Smart Reminder emails you. Recurring tasks, colour-coded categories, calendar view, offline-first. Free, with a banner ad.

records.name: World View
records.tagline: A 3D globe that helps kids explore all 195 countries
records.description: World View is a free 3D globe for kids. Spin it, tap any of the 195 countries and see its flag, capital, a fun fact and how far it is from home. Play Find it! to win stars and collect passport stamps. No sign-up, no ads, and it works offline.

records.name: Kite Agent
records.tagline: Chat with any model — or your own AI agent — from your phone
records.description: Kite is a chat client for iPhone, iPad and Android for any OpenAI-compatible model — OpenRouter, Groq, Together, or one running on your own Mac via Ollama or LM Studio — with your own key, no account. If you run Hermes, the open-source agent from Nous Research, Kite brings its tools, memory and files to your phone: watch every command it runs, or just say “Ask Kite.” Free for 14 days, then $24.99 once. No subscription.

records.name: Micro Notes: Private & Simple
records.tagline: Minimal note app
records.description: Micro Notes is a clean, local-first note-taking app for everyday notes. Create a note in seconds, organize it your way, and find it again when you need it. Features Your notes and preferences are stored locally on your device, and no account is required. You stay in control of your notes and backups. Micro Notes keeps note-taking simple: open the app, write what matters, and get back to your day.

records.name: Talk With Stranger
records.tagline: Random chat with games, voice calls and friends, no sign-up
records.description: New: games you can start inside a chat (Love Test, Hangman, Truth or Dare, Never Have I Ever), voice calls with strangers, and friends you can keep and message later. Talk With Stranger matches you with someone new for a one-to-one chat in a couple of seconds. No account, no app, any browser. Topic chat rooms, spam filters, report and block. 18+.

records.name: Eye treatment
records.tagline: Cortical Visual Impairment
records.description: Cortical Visual Impairment (CVI) is a unique condition that affects the brain’s ability to process visual information, leading to challenges in interpreting visual stimuli. Unlike other forms of visual impairment, CVI originates in the brain’s visual centers rather than the eyes themselves. Visual therapy has emerged as a promising avenue for individuals with CVI, offering hope and opportunities for improvement.

records.name: Insta360 Mic
records.tagline: A wireless mic with customizable E-Ink and pro audio
records.description: Insta360 Mic is a wireless microphone designed for creators who want professional audio with a personal touch. Customize its E-Ink display with your logo or artwork, record 32-bit float audio to your own microSD card, and capture clear voices with AI noise cancellation. It supports up to four transmitters, connects directly to compatible Insta360 cameras, and delivers up to 34 hours of battery life with the charging case.

records.name: GoResume
records.tagline: Speak your résumé in any language, tailor it to any job
records.description: GoResume is a free AI resume builder used by 1M+ job seekers. Speak your story in any language (Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Hindi…) or type it, and the AI drafts an English resume in under a minute. 99 ATS-friendly templates, a job-description tailor with match score and missing keywords, AI headshots from selfies, and a live goresume.io/u/you page that updates as you edit. Free to build and share; pay only for PDFs.

records.name: Safai
records.tagline: Clean, map and speed up your Mac or PC.
records.description: Safai is a fast, all-in-one cleaner for Mac and Windows. It finds the caches, duplicates, old downloads and developer junk eating your disk and clears them in one click. You also get a disk map, a startup manager, live memory and CPU, and a malware check, in a 17 MB app that maps your disk faster than CleanMyMac. Free for 7 days, then $29.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: Sayful

This one is simple and free.

records.name: Stylegrab

Set rules in plain English, block risky operations, require human approval, and protect sensitive data. Every decision is logged, so you stay in control without slowing your agents down.

records.description: Outscoped helps commercial cleaning companies price bids from labor hours and send Good, Better, Best proposals. Clients open the link on any device with no login, pick a package and sign online. Free plan included.

records.name: Word Sprouts
records.tagline: Read-aloud word searches for kids, Pre-K to 2nd grade
records.description: Word searches for Pre-K to 2nd grade that read every word aloud. Grown-ups can turn this week's spelling list into a puzzle in seconds. 60+ puzzles, three skill levels, works offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Free to try, pay once to unlock.

records.name: SpaceMap
records.tagline: See what is eating your Mac's disk on a zoomable map
records.description: SpaceMap is a free, open-source disk usage analyzer for macOS. It draws a folder or the whole disk as one nested treemap: folders are frames, files are tiles colored by type. The map fills in while the scan is still running, so you don't have to wait for it to finish. Double-click to zoom into a folder, click a file type to dim everything else, right-click to reveal, rescan or trash. Sizes match du. Native SwiftUI, about 1 MB, no dependencies.

records.name: Nurok
records.tagline: Living knowledge bases your AI agents can reuse
records.description: Every time an AI agent starts a task, it re-researches the same topic from scratch, burning tokens and time, with answers you can't always trace. Nurok does the research once. Each knowledge base is organised, fact-checked, sourced claim by claim and kept current. Plug it into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or OpenCode with the nurok-kb skill, and your agent spends tokens on the real problem. Live KBs include AI Technical Trends 2026, US Startup Programs and Pitch Deck 101.

records.name: LingTube
records.tagline: Learn languages from YouTube and Netflix videos
records.description: Dictionary lookups often give the wrong meaning when a word has several senses. LingTube uses the subtitle line and part of speech to give the meaning used in that sentence. It also adds part-of-speech colors with furigana and pinyin, grammar breakdowns with CEFR levels, transcription for videos without captions, shareable timestamped notes, danmaku on YouTube and Netflix, and AI Q&A that knows the video. YouTube chapters, heatmap and Shorts still work.

records.name: AX Notifications Template Migrator

By helping teams maintain template consistency and minimize migration errors, it makes notification template management more efficient and reliable throughout the deployment lifecycle.

records.name: Ghost Networks MCP

Enterprise plans start with a first month for $9.90.

records.name: Flax

Toft is where that history lives instead: every repair, warranty, and contractor, written down as it happens. So you know what's coming, buyers can see the value, and the next owner starts with the full record.

It also warns about potentially destructive commands, stops a sequence when a step fails, and keeps everything local—no account, cloud sync, or telemetry.

records.name: True Salary Calculator
records.tagline: Take-Home Pay Calculator 2026: US, UK, India & More
records.description: Type a salary, CTC or hourly rate and see what reaches your account in the US (every state), Canada, UK, Australia, Germany, India, Singapore, Japan and the UAE. Free, no sign-up. Includes Salary AI and a free MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.

records.name: Herwave - Women Only Travel
records.tagline: Women-Only App for Travel Buddies, Carpools & Parties
records.description: Herwave is a women-only app in India where every member is a verified woman. Find travel buddies near you, share women-only carpools on your commute and join women-only house parties and meetups. Free on Android.

records.name: Jobs without German
records.tagline: Jobs in Germany whose adverts don't ask for German
records.description: Jobs without German lists 3,800+ job adverts in Germany, Austria and German-speaking Switzerland that are written in English, and 3,100+ of them don't ask for German at all. Every listing gets a clear label: English is the working language, no German asked for, or German helps. Filter by city, role, contract type (working student, internship, PhD, freelance) and experience level. Refreshed nightly from 460+ employers' own career pages. Free, no sign-up, plus 22 newcomer guides.

records.name: Nolapso
records.tagline: Track subscriptions and contracts before they renew
records.description: Nolapso keeps subscriptions, free trials and contracts in one place and emails you before the next payment, the end of a trial or a contract's notice deadline. Add items by hand, from a PDF or from a forwarded email; AI proposes the dates with the source passage and you confirm them. See monthly and yearly totals, price increases and overlapping subscriptions. No bank connection. 10 languages. Free for 10 items, no card; Premium and Business add more.

records.name: Gate Ajar
records.tagline: Gate Ajar is a hidden-role card game played in the browser
records.description: A hidden-role party card game for the browser. Two secret factions, tarot cards and incomplete information. Find your allies before the gate opens. Play with friends or bots.

records.name: Micropaste
records.tagline: Visual clipboard manager for Windows 11
records.description: Micropaste keeps everything you copy on Windows 11 and shows it as rich cards: links, images, colors, code and files. Free, open source and local-first.

records.name: MorphGate
records.tagline: Open-source SSH client with a VPN per host and E2EE sync
records.description: MorphGate is an open-source SSH and SFTP client for Linux, macOS, Windows and Android. Each host can get its own WireGuard or OpenVPN tunnel inside the app, host keys are pinned, and your vault syncs end-to-end encrypted, through our server or your own.

records.name: Tanqueo
records.tagline: Find a gas station in Bolivia that's selling right now
records.description: Tanqueo shows you where to fill up now: a station near you that's selling gasoline or diesel and will likely still be selling when you get there. • Stations in all 9 departments of Bolivia • A map of who's selling now • The line, reported by other drivers • Your starred stations, right when you open the app • Alerts when a station starts selling, and a heads-up if it stops while you're on your way Free, no account needed. iPhone, Android and web.

records.name: IIJABIA
records.tagline: Exclusive Luxury Islamic Clothing for Men
records.description: Shop Iijabia's exclusive luxury Islamic clothing for men. Our selection of sophisticated, high-end garments is designed to provide comfort and elegance for every event.

records.name: Charted
records.tagline: Map your travels and keep the memories behind each place
records.description: Charted is a personal travel map and journal for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Apple Vision Pro. Mark where you have been, record visits with dates, notes and photos, and keep a wishlist for future journeys. Explore country and continent statistics, use the journal and flat maps offline, and export records as JSON. Optional one-time Pro adds region and city tracking, a globe, timeline, year cards and an unlimited wishlist. Features vary by platform.

records.name: almostcart
records.tagline: Browse what you want. Without the pressure to buy.
records.description: almostcart helps you pause before an impulse purchase. Browse simulated food, fashion and gadgets, add items to a cart, then release it without payment or delivery. Build a daily routine with Tiny Swap challenges, track real-world subscriptions, save wish lists and connect with friends through optional sharing. Available on iOS and Android, with a free plan and optional Almost Pro lifetime upgrade.

records.name: Snipp
records.tagline: Screenshot and clip sharing that blurs your personal info
records.description: Share screenshots and clips with one link. Edit them in a free browser editor, no account needed. Blur personal info yourself, ask Snippy, or turn on Blur Personal Info and it happens on upload. Works with ShareX, XerahS and Discord.

records.name: CastGhost
records.tagline: The next generation of podcast pitching. Get on better shows
records.description: CastGhost is the new way to find and pitch podcasts: a do-it-yourself, end-to-end podcast guest booking tool for experts, founders, and storytellers. Set up your profile once from your socials, website, and posts. CastGhost live searches for shows that interview guests like you, checks recent episodes for fit, and drafts every pitch in your voice from your own material. Send from your Gmail, with follow-ups drafted and replies tracked. No subscription: pay as you go.

records.name: Liquid edge trading
records.tagline: Institutional-Grade Online Trading Platform
records.description: Trade 1000+ instruments including currencies, stocks, indices, commodities, ETFs, and crypto CFDs with raw spreads from 0.0 pips, sub-10ms execution, and enterprise-grade security. Awarded Best Trading Platform at Investment Expo Dubai 2025.

records.name: PRAXIS
records.tagline: Carry chosen work through interruption.
records.description: Choose a piece of work and construct the boundary around it. Rehearse competing demands, carry the boundary into your day and keep the actual result. PRAXIS is a private instrument in ARMONEEY's Digital Sanctuary. $197, paid once.

records.name: Vytality Fitness
records.tagline: Strength training for 40+ — weekly goals, not daily streaks
records.description: Strength training built on a weekly budget instead of a daily streak — miss a day and the week still counts. An AI coach plans each session around your equipment, your injuries and how the last one felt. Built for people over 40. Free while we are in beta.

records.name: Grocerr AI
records.tagline: Know your kitchen. Cook what you already have.
records.description: Grocerr AI keeps track of your fridge, freezer and pantry and shows recipes you can cook right now. Scan food, build shared grocery lists, plan meals for the week and waste less. Made by Aerosoul Technologies, a new company in Chennai building apps for everyday life.

records.name: Is the Aurora Visible?
records.tagline: Tonight's Northern Lights Forecast
records.description: A plain answer to one question: will you see the northern lights tonight? Live visibility scores and month-by-month odds for the world’s best aurora destinations.

records.name: Free SERP Snippet Optimization Tool SEO
records.tagline: 10.	SERP Snippet Optimization Tool
records.description: Optimize your meta titles and descriptions with our free SERP snippet tool. Preview how your pages appear on Google and improve search visibility and clicks.

records.name: RVA SimpleBudget
records.tagline: Plan your spending without linking your bank
records.description: Build a monthly budget, record spending, and track recurring bills without connecting your bank. Start with the free plan, or try the no-signup calculator before creating an account.

records.name: Stuvelo
records.tagline: The CRM built for filmmakers
records.description: The CRM and project workspace built for filmmakers and creative studios. Manage clients, projects, invoices, and deliverables in one place.

records.name: CombienVautMonLogement
records.tagline: Free AI home valuations. No signup. No spam.
records.description: Discover your home's estimated value in France with AI, real estate transaction data and interactive maps. No account, no personal details, no unwanted calls. Explore local property prices, market trends and free tools. Connect with an advisor only when you choose.

records.name: Lahore Analytica
records.tagline: ERP Implementation Cost Calculator
records.description: Benchmark real-time implementation costs, hourly consulting rates, and rollout timelines for Odoo Enterprise, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle NetSuite, and SAP S/4HANA—including Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Copilot, Gemini, and Claude AI integrations across all regions. Interactive ERP Implementation Cost & Timeline Estimator (Odoo, Oraclce, Dynamics, SAP).

records.name: skillax ai academy
records.tagline: wayanad manandhavady
records.description: Skillax emphasizes a practical, agency-style learning model where students work on live client projects, technical website audits, and active ad campaign management to build a professional portfolio.

records.name: Comity
records.tagline: coordination for your team's AI coding agents
records.description: A vendor-neutral coordination layer for teams' AI coding agents: shared awareness, conflict detection before code is written, policy enforcement through agent hooks, and an audit trail.

records.name: InSnap
records.tagline: Snap it. Mark it. Send it.
records.description: Hover to auto-detect any window or button, drag, annotate, pin it on top. Erase objects, copy text with offline OCR, stitch scrolling screenshots, record and edit video with auto zoom. Mac & Windows.

records.name: zemix
records.tagline: 사이드 프로젝트 메이커 커뮤니티
records.description: 유저를 만나고, 함께 만드는 사이드 프로젝트 플랫폼 (zemix.vercel.app)

records.name: Y-Track
records.tagline: Telegram Traffic Tracker
records.description: We built YTrack to solve the black-box problem in Telegram marketing. Marketers waste thousands on Meta/Google Ads because they can't accurately track conversions or feed S2S/CAPI data back to optimize ad algorithms.

records.name: Truck Finder: Driver Loads
records.tagline: Empty truck? Get load offers from FMCSA-verified brokers.
records.description: Truck Finder helps truck drivers find loads. Free forever for drivers. Brokers find empty trucks and send offers (brokers pay $9.99/mo or $107.88/yr after a 7-day trial). FMCSA-verified brokers, broker and driver trust info, and a 'Where I'm headed' destination setting. US and Canada.

records.name: SongBlast
records.tagline: Turn your song into ready-to-post TikToks, Reels & Shorts
records.description: Upload your song and a few of your own clips. Otis, SongBlast's AI editor, finds the hook, syncs your lyrics and cuts promo videos for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and Facebook, then schedules them. Your music and footage stay 100% human-made. Free to start.

records.name: Followback
records.tagline: See who doesn't follow you back on Instagram, no login
records.description: See who doesn't follow you back and who unfollowed you on Instagram. No login and no password: it reads the data export Instagram gives you, right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

records.name: PingCron
records.tagline: Know when your scheduled jobs miss a check-in
records.description: Know when a scheduled job misses its check-in. Keep your existing scheduler and get email, Slack or Discord alerts after the grace period. Start with 5 free monitors, 7 days of history and no credit card.

records.name: Syed Zameer
records.tagline: Performance Marketing and Lead Generation
records.description: Syed Zameer is a performance marketing and growth specialist working across paid media, lead generation, conversion optimisation and the tracking systems behind them.

records.name: DecibeldBMeter
records.tagline: Know Your Noise. Measure Every Decibel.
records.description: Explore the sound around you with a free microphone-powered decibel meter, live graphs and a sound level guide. Private, on-device sound measurement.

records.name: GrowWithGoyal
records.tagline: - Digital Marketing Agency
records.description: Explore digital marketing services at GrowWithGoyal, including SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, email marketing, social media marketing, and product listing. Contact our agency today!

records.name: Angel Wing Memorial Ring – Heavenly Gems
records.tagline: Beautiful Angel Wing Memorial Ring symbolizing love.
records.description: A meaningful memorial ring for anyone wishing to keep the memory of a loved one close, featuring an elegant angel wing design.

records.name: Brievora
records.tagline: Run client projects from brief to handoff in Obsidian
records.description: Brievora is a ready-made Obsidian vault for freelancers and small studios. It follows a client project from the first brief to the handoff: briefs, scope changes with their billable hours, feedback rounds counted against what you included, tasks, deliverables, proposals and invoices, all linked to the same client. Everything is plain Markdown on your disk, and Brievora has no account or server. Brievora Lite is free; the full vault is a one-time payment.

records.name: R8API
records.tagline: One gateway. Multiple AI models.
records.description: R8API is a unified AI API relay service. Connect to multiple models with one platform key through OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API formats, and pay based on usage. Model access depends on key permissions and service availability.

records.name: ChartTrainer
records.tagline: Free Trading Simulator
records.description: ChartTrainer is a web based trading simulator for traders preparing for prop firm evaluations. It replays futures, forex, crypto and stock sessions candle by candle, so you practice decisions without knowing what comes next, runs evaluation accounts with prop firm style rules, journals every trade and shows what to fix. It also has a Pine Script style editor, 101 built in indicators and strategies and a strategy backtester. It is free to start and runs in any browser on desktop and phone.

records.name: OVARIANA
records.tagline: women’s health, observations and knowledge
records.description: OVARIANA supports everyday life between appointments: the observations you want to keep, the topics you want to explore and the questions you want to return to. !!!!! Before you scroll !!!!!: OVARIANA is built for women. You may never use it yourself. Someone you care about might: your partner, sister, mother, daughter or friend. It does not diagnose, assess risk or replace medical advice. If you’re a doctor, consider the other side of the appointment: patients arriving with a structured history

records.name: HK12 Pro Series 12 Smartwatch
records.tagline: HK12 Pro Series 12 Smartwatch
records.description: HK12 Pro Series 12 Smartwatch A big 2.02-inch AMOLED display, calls straight from your wrist, and a premium look without the premium price. 2.02-inch AMOLED display Bluetooth calling — make and receive calls from your wrist Health tracking: steps, heart rate and sleep Smart notifications for calls, messages and apps Customisable watch faces Works with Android and iOS Available in Black, Gold and Silver Premium style, smart features, everyday convenience. Order now from Urbanstore India.

records.name: Proof
records.tagline: Design pro websites from what 400+ real sites do best
records.description: AI guesses what a good page looks like. Proof learned it from 400+ real product pages. One short brief → the right sections, in the right order, in your brand. It self-checks and never invents facts.

records.name: Buddiz
records.tagline: Trouve des sportifs de ton niveau près de chez toi
records.description: Padel, tennis, running, foot 5, rando, vélo, fitness. Trouve des partenaires à ton niveau près de chez toi et rejoins leurs sessions. 100% gratuit.

records.name: FillMatic
records.tagline: Form Filler Extension for Realistic Test Data
records.description: FillMatic is a browser extension that fills web forms with realistic, locale-aware fake data, reusable Actions, Profiles, and Recipes for developers and testers.

records.name: AP LandGrid
records.tagline: Find any survey number in Andhra Pradesh on a satellite map
records.description: Satellite map of Andhra Pradesh land survey numbers: boundaries, area, village, mandal and district across all 26 districts.

records.name: powerlink
records.tagline: Connect with Trust
records.description: A sophisticated social hub that intelligently bridges personal interests with professional opportunities, featuring secure community-driven marketplaces, anonymous networking, and an AI-powered personal assistant.

records.name: Linkuild Guest Post Finder
records.tagline: Find sites accepting guest posts in any niche, free
records.description: Enter a niche and get 22 ready-made Google and Bing search operators that find "write for us" pages, guest post guidelines, contributor and sponsored post opportunities. One-click search or copy, country filters (UK, CA, AU, IN), and an option to exclude Medium, LinkedIn and other UGC sites. Runs fully in your browser: no sign-up, no email, no limits. Includes a short guide to vetting sites and a pitch template.

records.name: LAS Converter
records.tagline: Free online video to MP3, compressor & Facebook downloader
records.description: LAS Converter is a free online media converter. Turn video into MP3, compress video, convert images and audio, and download Facebook videos. Conversions run in your browser, so files stay on your device. Made in Nigeria. Optional Premium plan.

records.name: PROFESSIONAL 1-Ply Dyed Window Tint Film
records.tagline: Single-layer dyed window film for automotive tinting
records.description: PROFESSIONAL 1-Ply Dyed Window Tint Film by United Auto Film offers a traditional dyed tint in a single-layer construction for automotive applications. It provides a straightforward option for installers and vehicle owners seeking a tinted appearance, complementing our range of carbon and ceramic window films.

records.name: Ferry
records.tagline: a fast, compact, versatile dual-pane file manager for macOS
records.description: Ferry is like Finder on steroids. A much better file manager experience for your Mac. Ferry is a lightweight, native macOS file manager that brings all the file manipulation tools you need into one app. It keeps what works in Finder and improves on the rest, while staying fast, private, and packed with features without getting in your way. Works on macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

records.name: Revenue First Analytics for WooCommerce
records.tagline: Analytics that shows which traffic brings revenue.
records.description: Self-hosted, privacy-first WooCommerce analytics that puts sales before pageviews. Every WooCommerce order is attributed to the channel, campaign and landing page that brought the buyer, and all data stays in your own WordPress database. Features: * Revenue by channel, campaign, landing page and country * Funnels and goals show where shoppers drop off * Cookieless privacy mode, no banner required * Works with WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads * Includes MCP and Direct developer support

records.name: PinBridge
records.tagline: Pinterest publishing for AI assistants, automations and apps
records.description: Publish and schedule Pinterest pins from an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT, from n8n workflows, or through a REST API.

records.name: Kept
records.tagline: Turn ideas into action. AI planner: tasks, notes, calendar
records.description: I built what I wish Notion, Craft Notes, and Things 3 felt like together. What makes this app different from the many todo apps on product hunt: - Goal tracking makes the app built around helping you actually achieve your productive goals, rather than making you do the work of being organized yourself. - Todos use Apple Intelligence on device to auto sort tasks into areas that you define [making them easily searchable later] - Integrated calendar, tasks, and notes work and sync on iPhone, Mac.

records.name: SanDe: Habit & Goal Tracker
records.tagline: Your best day — workouts, food, water & habits
records.description: SanDe — Your best day. Goals, habits, wellbeing, workouts and notes — in one calm, beautiful app. No sign-up and no clutter. All your data stays on your phone. SanDe works without an account. Your goals, notes, workouts and progress are stored only on your device — we don't collect or share them. Some features are available in Premium — a one-time purchase, no subscription. Start with one small.

records.name: OpenWhen
records.tagline: Letters that stay sealed until the right moment
records.description: In February OpenWhen was a Valentine's love letter. Now it's sealed letters for any moment. Lock one to a date, or to a question only they can answer. We can email it to them and nudge them the day it opens. New since then: note jars that open one note a day, group jars a whole team signs, a hand-drawn signature, and replies so they can write back. Still free, and still no account for anyone. Premium is one payment, never a subscription.

records.name: Kopi
records.tagline: Open-source clipboard manager for Mac and Windows
records.description: Kopi is an open-source clipboard manager for macOS and Windows. Unlimited history, instant search, pinboards and snippets, kept on your computer. The alpha is free to download.

records.name: SkyWallpaper
records.tagline: Best wallpaper app for Android TV
records.description: ✅ Photo & Live Wallpapers: Upload or choose stunning photo or live wallpapers that adapt to your style. ✅ Time & Weather Display: Your wallpaper shows the current time and weather in real-time. ✅ Spotify Playlist Integration: Request your favorite Spotify playlist to play alongside your wallpaper. ✅ Custom Music Search (Coming Soon). ✅ Live Weather: Enjoy beautiful weather that match the forecast. Currently available only on Google play store for TV.

records.name: lovelypdf.tech
records.tagline: 41 free PDF tools · 74 formats to Word · 55 languages
records.description: Most PDF sites work best in English. LovelyPDF offers 41 free PDF tools in 55 languages, including Urdu, Bangla, Hindi, Indonesian, Portuguese and Spanish. Highlights: KING TOOL turns 74 file formats into editable Word documents; scanned PDFs and images become editable with OCR while signatures and stamps stay untouched; Compress to an exact size with an honest estimate per file; plus PDF to Excel and PowerPoint, Merge, Split and Office to PDF. Free, no sign-up, no install.

records.name: Kombucha
records.tagline: Limit MacBook charging to extend battery lifespan
records.description: A MacBook that stays on its adapter spends its life at 100%, where a lithium-ion cell ages fastest. Kombucha holds the battery inside a range you choose: it stops charging at the upper threshold and resumes at the lower one, so the Mac runs from the adapter while the battery rests. Also: Charge to 100% Once, Heat Protection, discharge to the limit, history charts, battery health. Free and open source (MIT), no network access or telemetry. Apple Silicon, macOS 15–26.

records.name: CLIENT ZERO
records.tagline: Grow revenue by keeping the customers you have
records.description: Your customers are already there: bring them back more often. Free 2-minute diagnostic for small businesses: 7 questions, no sign-up, your main leak plus 3 concrete actions to make customers come back. PRO (€49, one-time) adds a step-by-step method, follow-up templates and 4 AI assistants. French-language tool.

records.name: MyTrusted.ai
records.tagline: Chat with top AI models, with safety you can see.
records.description: MyTrusted.ai is an AI chat app that lets you use several leading AI models in one place, with SASKI safety rules running on every message. SASKI is deterministic: it catches crisis signals and points people to 988 resources, and removes personal details like phone numbers and addresses before they reach the AI, the same way every time. Every safety decision is recorded without storing your words. The first 100 sign-ups get 2 million free tokens. Learn more at www.saski.io

records.name: Nenvik
records.tagline: Job management and websites for Australian trades
records.description: Nenvik is job management software built for Australian trade and service businesses. Win work with a business website and online booking, send quotes customers sign and accept online, schedule the crew, record work from a phone (time, checklists, photos, on-site customer sign-off) and invoice with card payments. Website, booking, quotes, jobs, customer portal and invoicing in one subscription. 15-day free trial, no card.

records.name: ModernReader
records.tagline: Read with rhythm. Feel the words.
records.description: Reading long text is exhausting — your eyes fatigue, your mind wanders, and plain TTS sounds like a robot reading a manual. ModernReader is a multi-sensory AI reading system on the CRA model: parse Markdown/EPUB/TXT, read aloud with rhythm-aware voice, tag emotions (EN & ZH), and AI-summarize. Runs as PWA, desktop, or Capacitor shell — self-host via Docker. Built for deep readers, students, and anyone with visual fatigue. Finalist — 2026 Cross-Strait Entrepreneurship Competition.

records.name: FattyURL
records.tagline: Free URL Shortener, No Sign Up Needed
records.description: Free URL shortener with no sign up, no login and no account required. Short links that never expire with a free account, plus full click analytics.

records.name: Kipt
records.tagline: Onboarding that reacts when users get stuck
records.description: Kipt helps SaaS founders turn more signups into activated users. Build onboarding flows with welcome pop-ups, checklists, tooltips, emails, and questions. Kipt watches for signs a user is stuck, like hesitating, abandoning a form, or preparing to leave, then reacts in real time with the right nudge and a plain-English explanation for why it fired. A/B test every step and automatically keep the winners. From $29/mo.

records.name: RecipeRun
records.tagline: Save recipes, plan meals, and shop together
records.description: Turn recipes from websites, TikTok, YouTube and handwritten cards into a weekly meal plan and one grocery list your household can share. RecipeRun brings recipe imports, serving adjustments, Cook Mode and family collaboration together on iPhone and Android. Free to start, with no ads. Pro adds unlimited AI imports, Family Groups, nutrition estimates and cloud options. Australian users can also compare indicative grocery prices at Woolworths, Coles and ALDI.

records.name: PantryPalz
records.tagline: Stop throwing out food you forgot about
records.description: The average American throws away $728 of food a year (US EPA), and most of it was bought on purpose, then forgotten. PantryPalz shows you what to eat first. Snap a grocery receipt and the whole shop goes in, or scan a barcode or the printed date. You get a reminder the day before food spoils, plus recipe ideas built around what needs using up. Your food list stays on your iPhone and works offline. No ads. The yearly plan starts with a free week.

records.name: Medrive - Unlimited Cloud Storage
records.tagline: like onedrive just it's unlimited
records.description: - Unlimited Cloud Storage: Use your own private Telegram channel to store your files securely. - Windows File Explorer Integration: Access your cloud drive directly in Windows File Explorer, just like a local drive and Sync in background. - Fast Transfers: Upload and download files quickly and reliably. - Privacy First: Your files are stored directly in your private Telegram storage, not on our servers. MeDrive does not collect or sell your personal data.

records.name: AI Rank Inspector
records.tagline: SEO, AEO and GEO Checker Extension for Chrome
records.description: AI Rank Inspector is a free, comprehensive Chrome extension and web audit platform designed for modern Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It delivers instant, deep technical audits, LLM visibility scoring, and actionable recommendations to help websites rank across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude search engines. Zero bloat, instant on-page insights, and complete competitor analysis.

records.name: Quantum L7 AI
records.tagline: AI, communities, learning & digital markets in one place
records.description: Quantum L7 AI is a multilingual digital ecosystem connecting social experiences, AI-powered market exploration, learning, and digital commerce. Discover Qline Forum, Communities, QCast, AI Box, Academy, MetaMarket, and Quantum Wallet in one evolving platform. Unlike standalone apps, these products are designed to work together through a shared experience. Explore what is available today, share feedback, and help shape future quests and virtual worlds.
